comment: shk.c onbill() and sub_one_frombill() reports for an unpaid object eaten on no bill. Seed 8452280's Dlvl 4 has a delicatessen whose keeper stands at (56,18) inside an open door at (55,18); a debug-mode Samurai who level-teleports there lands at (57,16) on 2 tripe rations (port-only scanSeeds() probe over 8452000-8452400 for a hero who lands on an object inside a shop with its keeper at home: 16 hits, this one chosen for food). He picks them up (unpaid), hurls the keeper west through the door with #wiztelekinesis (wizcmds.c wiz_telekinesis() -> mhurtle()), wishes for a hole under himself and plunges through it with '>'. shk.c u_left_shop() returns early because the keeper is not inhishop(), so the rations stay unpaid on Dlvl 5, where no bill holds them. He eats one with 'e': mkobj.c splitobj() reaches shk.c splitbill() ("splitbill: no resident shopkeeper??"), eat.c touchfood() calls shk.c costly_alteration(COST_BITE) (eat.c 371), whose "You bite that tripe ration, you pay for it!" names the ration (unpaid_cost()'s report), and billing the bite reaches shk.c onbill() with no shopkeeper ("onbill: unpaid obj without shopkeeper?", 1151-1152) and sub_one_frombill() ("sub_one_frombill: unpaid object not on bill", 3687). The port's onbill() and sub_one_frombill() are synchronous and queue those reports for the next message. Seed, datetime, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session and batch game.
